Per-cell copy-number states on the MEDICC2 pieces

Source: R/medicc2_cells.R
cell_piece_states.Rd

For each cell x piece, the candidates of cell_piece_candidates() (1:1 plus every oriented (cn_a, cn_b) a kept clone has on the piece; haploid pieces: one-copy states) are scored with the cell's own evidence (cell_piece_data()); the cell's clone assignment is not used.

  • Depth: ll_depth_shift(z, mu, tpar) with mu = c * log2(max(cn, 0.2) / base) / pmax(sd, sd_floor) (the shift model of the clone states, fit_clone_states() / assign_cells(): base = the piece ploidy when the depth is centred on the reference pool, else 2), relative to the neutral state's shift (the neutral state's own depth term is ll_depth_shift(z, 0) = 0), Student-t null per sd_class x stratum (fit_depth_null() parameters, fallbacks as in assign_cells()) or Gaussian when tpar is NULL.

  • Alleles: one-sided beta-binomial LLR vs 1:1 of the oriented votes (oA, oN) at the expected cn_a fraction 0.5 + a * (cn_a / cn - 0.5) (a = orientation attenuation of the clone model; 0.5 for cn = 0), overdispersion rho; haploid pieces have no allele term.

  • MAP over the candidates with the prior (neutral, uniform or clone_freq); posterior is the MAP's posterior and llr_neutral the log-likelihood (no prior) of the MAP minus that of the neutral state.

Usage

cell_piece_states(
  features,
  pieces,
  blocks = NULL,
  cells = NULL,
  params = caller_defaults(),
  prior = c("neutral", "uniform", "clone_freq"),
  p_neutral = 0.5,
  clones = NULL,
  c = NULL,
  a = NULL,
  rho = "ref",
  tpar = NULL,
  ref_cells = NULL,
  loo = NULL,
  normal = "N0",
  sd_scale = TRUE,
  ref_center = c("pseudobulk", "mean"),
  center = TRUE,
  s_sys = NULL,
  haploid_sd = sqrt(2),
  data = NULL,
  keep_ll = FALSE,
  rho_grid = c(0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.08, 0.12, 0.18, 0.25)
)

Arguments

features

scn_features list (see cell_piece_data())

pieces

clone x piece table with cn_a, cn_b (orient_clone_states()$pieces or the export's pieces.tsv), or a medicc2_orientation

blocks

block orientation (orient_clone_states()$blocks); NULL takes it from a medicc2_orientation

cells

cells to score (default all)

params

caller_defaults() (sd_floor, eps, tile_sizes)

prior

neutral (default), uniform or clone_freq (see cell_piece_candidates()). Under the uniform prior a short piece with many candidates and little evidence goes to whichever non-neutral state fits marginally better, so many rows of normal cells get non-neutral states; clone_freq gives uninformative cells the majority clone state (tumour states in normal cells)

p_neutral

neutral prior mass of prior = "neutral"

clones

clones table (clone, c, a, n_assigned); used for the default c / a and the clone_freq prior

c, a

global depth contrast and allelic attenuation (NULL = cell-weighted median of the tumour clones; 1 when clones lacks them)

rho

beta-binomial overdispersion of a cell's oriented votes on a piece: a number; "ref" = fitted (fit_bb_rho(), f = 0.5) on the reference cells' oriented votes (diploid pieces; the reference pool is balanced everywhere, so it is the null of the allele channel, as it is the per-cell null of the caller); "auto" = the value of rho_grid that maximises the marginal likelihood of all scored cell x piece rows over their candidates (with the prior); NULL = the features' / run's allelic null rho. The run's null rho is fitted on votes oriented by the all-cell pseudobulk, which on event-free regions is a random orientation; in the true haplotype frame of the block orientation a single cell's votes on a piece are far more dispersed (often by an order of magnitude).

tpar

depth null t parameters (class, stratum, t_m, t_s, t_df) or NULL (Gaussian)

ref_cells

reference pool for the depth centring

loo

NULL or data.table cell, clone (see cell_piece_data())

normal

name of the normal clone (excluded from the default c / a)

sd_scale, ref_center, center, haploid_sd

see cell_piece_data()

s_sys

systematic depth SD added to the per-cell SD (NULL = the cell-weighted median of the tumour clones' s_sys, 0 when clones lacks it); see cell_piece_data()

data

precomputed cell_piece_data() output (skips the depth / vote aggregation)

keep_ll

return the per-candidate log-likelihoods

rho_grid

grid of rho = "auto"

Value

list of class cell_piece_states: states (one row per cell x piece: cell, piece, chrom, start, end, ploidy, cn_a, cn_b, state (MAP), posterior, llr_neutral, ll_depth, ll_allele (MAP terms vs neutral), n_cand, z, log2ratio, offset, sd, n_win, oA, oN (oriented votes), f_obs (oA / oN), n_blocks), candidates, ll (cell x piece x candidate, when keep_ll), params (c, a, rho, rho_mode, rho_rows (reference rows of the rho fit), rho_ml (the auto grid), s_sys, ref_center, center, prior, n_ref, loo, sd_scale, depth_null)

Details

c, a and s_sys are global (one value for every cell): by default the median over the tumour clones (kept clones of pieces except normal), weighted by their assigned cells, of the clones' fitted c / a / s_sys (clones table). A per-cell value would have to come from the cell's clone, which this function must not use.
